rules.why: existing desktop and companion homes, backups and lease recovery must open the same data
existing localStorage and native attestation records keep their keys
phone preferences and already posted notification intents survive the namespace move
posted phone notification and service intents keep their identity
existing paired and cloud credentials stay addressable, including the plist access-group selector
the installed Android application id and sandbox are unchanged
HPKE labels are part of the paired phone credential protocol
old phone clients continue discovering the existing server service
old QR codes remain readable; server emission stays old until both native apps have shipped support
HTTP authentication headers, discovery and domain verification still interoperate with 1.9.1
stored backups, portable packages and peer metadata retain their schema identifiers
IPC and updater restart arguments preserve mixed-version desktop recovery
a new server must lock the same data-directory lease as an existing process
existing managed containers, labels and pinned image entry points remain recognized
existing launchd/systemd units, fleet roots and firewall tables continue addressing the same installation
legacy app health identity is checked by old clients and updater preflight
external status publisher still writes its existing bridge path
pinned third-party binaries and historical upstream provenance cannot be redirected by a product rename

rules.pattern: fork of OpenMausBot|Milind Soni and OpenMausBot contributors
rules.why: Apache attribution to upstream contributors remains intact
restart preflight must still recognize old server processes
speech keychain items and native helper endpoint keep their identity
old environment spellings are resolved centrally and retain the same trust boundary
existing OS permission identity of the native control and speech helpers stays the same
external engine plugin grants and stored injected model ids keep their existing labels
existing local VM container remains recognizable rather than becoming an orphan
escaped link parsers and desktop scheme registration keep accepting saved links
existing worker databases, service health identities and hosted addresses must not become a different service
stored engine provider and built-in MCP identities remain reserved and cleanable
service actions continue controlling the already installed unit
legacy launchd/systemd and provider subprocess environment labels stay accepted; the central resolver always prefers the new spelling
already delivered phone notifications retain their registered action categories
existing message and skill delimiters are still readable by the current parsers
legacy QR scheme remains part of the native acceptance tests
saved phone fallback routes continue resolving the same stable LAN hostname
the existing upstream playbook library remains the configured source until a BOS library is published
published SHA-256 fixture input and expected digest must stay paired
credential access checks must deny both legacy and renamed app directories
case-insensitive filesystem access must still deny the legacy credential directory
case normalization uses the same synthetic legacy hostname on input and output
container probes must check the frozen health identity returned by old and new servers
